viewing_check: Estimate $20-40, current bid $10, 22% premium. At viewing: (1) VRC Cup Day racebook, read the year on the cover/first page and the winner listed; 1920s-1945 = bid up to ~A$100+, 1950s-70s = worth ~A$20-60. Check for pencilled results, completeness, staples. (2) Year of the HTC and Caulfield racebooks. (3) Botany Bay imprint at the foot of the cover: J. Walch & Sons Hobart c.1930 is A$30-60; an E.W. Cole or 19th-century edition would be better. (4) Dig through the pile for anything not photographed (more racebooks, pre-1920 items). Otherwise not worth more than ~A$50-60 all in.
